reason: The operator's Effort level, subagent reasoning_effort and Core's own reasoning_effort='none' (final-answer recovery, the capability probe, naming, compaction, retrieval planning, scope import) were translated only for OpenRouter's reasoning object and OpenAI o*/gpt-5 names, and silently dropped everywhere else (audit MODEL-3, NAT-12), so thinking could be neither turned down nor off: recovery from a reasoning-only synthesis re-thought on DeepSeek, Z.ai and local runtimes, and native adapters ignored the level. providers.py now translates the level per family: DeepSeek flavor/host thinking.type + reasoning_effort low|high|max; Z.ai/BigModel GLM 4.5+ thinking with clear_thinking:false (which turns on #502's Z.ai reasoning replay) + reasoning_effort high|max on GLM-5.2+; vLLM/SGLang chat_template_kwargs enable_thinking (GLM 4.5+, Qwen3) or thinking (DeepSeek V3.1+) and Ollama reasoning_effort; Anthropic and Bedrock Claude output_config.effort with adaptive (4.6+, summarized) or budget thinking (pre-4.6), none -> thinking disabled except Fable/Mythos (lowest effort instead), no thinking beside a forced tool choice, Bedrock's forced-choice disable kept and Opus 5's effort capped at high there; Gemini thinkingLevel (3.x) / thinkingBudget (2.5) with includeThoughts and thought parts read as reasoning; Responses reasoning.effort + summary auto with summaries read as reasoning. OpenRouter stores the catalog's reasoning.mandatory per model and never sends it (or Fable/Mythos) effort none, and Fable 5.1/Mythos get tool_choice auto on Chat Completions routes. #498's resend-without-the-disable now covers every family's disable and the Responses and Anthropic adapters, and Responses resends without summary when summaries are refused. tests/v3/test_reasoning_controls.py (90 tests; 72 fail on origin/main, the other 18 are guards that a route with no control, or an unset level, is sent nothing) proves it; the selected node ids are the existing tests that directly drive _openrouter_reasoning, _refused_reasoning_off_retry, the Chat Completions reasoning/tool_choice branches, the Anthropic/Bedrock temperature and forced-choice gating, Z.ai/DeepSeek host detection, reasoning replay and the OpenRouter catalog parser.
exclusions: No frontend tests: no ui/ change. No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No Playwright: area:core-api (the real-Core journey suite matched through providers.py/model_catalog.py) runs no DeepSeek, Z.ai, local-runtime, Anthropic, Bedrock, Gemini or Responses profile and never inspects reasoning fields; the Python tests drive the payloads directly. test_providers.py, test_chat.py, test_api.py, test_chat_tool_loop.py, test_chat_routing_tolerance.py, test_native_adapter_requests.py, test_native_adapter_outcomes.py, test_inference_timeouts_probe_budget.py, test_deepseek_glm_compat.py, test_reasoning_replay.py, test_reasoning_recovery.py, test_openai_compatible_parameters.py, test_openai_compatible_robustness.py, test_provider_contracts.py, test_provider_verification.py, test_synthesis_tool_declarations.py, test_native_tool_markup.py, test_chat_final_synthesis_recovery.py, test_model_output_budget.py and test_context.py were run locally in full (854 passed) but are not selected. No full suites.
